name: com.driftsys.dashscene
description: The C# side of dashscene. The boundary-B value types, the host that sits on the C ABI — version negotiation, runtime lifetime, document load, the tick and the committed frame — and the BatchRendererGroup painter that draws those tables. No native library yet, and the painter draws a subset of the document: this package's README lists what it draws and what it does not, and PackDiagnostic names the gap at run time rather than dropping it quietly.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that loads a .dsb, ticks it, hands each committed frame to BrgPainter and marks it drawn. Needs a host project meeting R-E4, R-E5 and R-E6 — a URP asset with the SRP Batcher on, and m_BrgStripping set to 2 — or the painter refuses to construct, or packs every instance and draws nothing.
